relations.statement: In a sweet-spot chain, bulk pairs contain neither the left nor the right boundary Majorana mode, so the edge modes are decoupled from the bulk pairing.

lemmas.statement: The sweet-spot chain has free edge modes gamma_1 and gamma_{2L} not appearing in any bulk pair.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem edge_free (L : Nat) (K : KitaevSweetSpotChain L) : (∀ pair ∈ K.bulk_pairs, pair.1 ≠ K.left_mzm ∧ pair.2 ≠ K.left_mzm) := (mzm_boundary_decoupling L K).1

near_misses.claim: A physical nanowire realizes the Kitaev chain without disorder or trivial subgap states.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The target is an imported model assumption only; no realization claim is supported (see BOTTLENECK).

near_misses.claim: The topological phase persists for |mu|<2t when Delta=0.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Requires Delta nonzero; with Delta=0 the chain is a trivial number-conserving chain with no Majorana edge modes.
